        if gross_income > TaxCalculator._GROSS_INCOME_THRESHOLD and gross_income > TaxCalculator._ROUNDING_THRESHOLD:
            # Non-standard rounding: round to the nearest 1000
            taxable_income = round(taxable_income / 1000) * 1000
        return taxable_income

    @staticmethod
    def _lookup_bracket_rate(taxable_income: float) -> float:
        """
        Private helper 2: Returns the marginal tax rate based on taxable income.
        """
        if taxable_income <= 10000:
            return 0.10
        elif taxable_income <= 40000:
            return 0.20
        elif taxable_income <= 90000:
            return 0.30
        else:
            return 0.40

    @staticmethod
    def calculate_tax_withholding(gross_income: float, deductions: float = 0.0) -> float:
        """
        Orchestrator: Computes tax withholding by calling _gross_to_taxable and _lookup_bracket_rate.
        """
        taxable_income = TaxCalculator._gross_to_taxable(gross_income, deductions)
        tax_rate = TaxCalculator._lookup_bracket_rate(taxable_income)
        return taxable_income * tax_rate
